characters.continuity: Peter Pan (1953 film), Peter Pan & Pirates (1990-1991 TV series), and Disney Comics
characters.summary: Captain James Hook is a theatrical, vengeful pirate captain armed with a rapier and a deadly hook hand. While cunning and ruthless in commanding his pirate crew, he is plagued by cowardice and paranoia regarding the Crocodile that bit off his hand.

weaknesses: Pathological fear of the ticking Crocodile
Arrogance and vanity easily exploited by foes
Extreme phobia of the Tick-Tock Crocodile

Lacks one hand, replaced by a metal hook
